title: New Permission Set form asks for the API Name before the Label and leaves Label optional (#27521 row 16)
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CY2n1JmZZKrHgtp9jC

Filing gate: ② a wrong or confusing state shown to the user. Split from #27521 row 16 by the seat; the parent's acceptance says each row is taken as its own card or answered.

## Business reason

Who: every administrator creating a permission set. What happens: the form opens on Name (the API name) with Label below it and optional, so the administrator types a machine name first and can save a set with no human label. Name derivation from Label already works on main, so the order fights the derivation. Reach: every administrator creating a set.

## Mechanism

- `packages/spec/src/security/permission.form.ts` orders Name before Label and leaves Label optional.
- The ui half (one message instead of three on a bad name) is the sibling card split from the same row.

Measured at `main` @ `561b7642`, re-driven (stock `examples/app-showcase --seed-admin`, admin, Chromium 1440×900).

## Wanted

Label first and required; Name after it, derived from the Label.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The Permission Set form lists Label before Name, and Label is required.
- [ ] The spec form test pins the order and the required flag.

Refs #27521
